hypothesis: Within a species, right- and left-handed parastichy directions are about equally frequent.
pass_criterion: Share of clockwise heads is within 45-55% and a binomial test fails to reject p=0.5 (p>0.05).
interpretation: Thompson's data were Norway spruce cones. The sunflower dataset tests the generalisation in another species, so a pass would not replicate the spruce figures (224 vs 243).
